sources.note: Main homepage describing Picasso as cloud-based EHR/PM/RCM suite. Claims first cloud PM product (2000) and first integrated PM+EHR (2004). Targets independent practices, clinically integrated networks, and billing companies.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists Picasso version 8.2 certification, pricing (subscription includes e-prescribing via NewCrop and patient portal), additional costs for immunization submissions and MIPS reporting via Healthmonics Registry. Lists third-party integrations: NewCrop Core, Clinical Exchange, NLM AccessGUDID API.

EHR features page. Describes documentation methods (point-and-click, voice dictation, body diagrams), 1000+ specialty templates, smart templates, simultaneous multi-user charting, lab results with discrete data, document management, Cloud+ offline read-only access.

Practice management features page. Details scheduling, registration, eligibility verification, charge posting (CPT/HCPCS), claims management with automatic clean claim generation, payment posting/reconciliation, patient payment plans, KPI dashboards, multi-location/multi-provider support.

Patient portal (Picasso Community) page. Describes secure messaging, health records access (medication history, clinical summaries), appointment scheduling/requests, patient-entered health information, online bill payment, patient education materials.

RCM page. Describes claims management, billing, real-time financial analytics, KPI dashboard (co-pays, AR, denials, cash flow), denial management, daily appointment tracking, point-of-service collections optimization.

About page. Founded 2000 by physicians and IT professionals. Harris Healthcare acquired Doc-tor.com in 2019 (announced Feb 2020). Mentions partnerships with IBM, Microsoft, Oracle, Nuance, Dragon. Harris 'Software for Life' / never divests policy.

Blog post about Harris acquisition. Doc-tor.com joins Harris Healthcare / Amazing Charts family alongside Harris CareTracker, digiChart, Clinix, MEDfx, Pulse. Harris has 2,300+ employees and 10,000+ customers across sectors.

Third-party EMR review aggregator. Zero user reviews. Lists features including simultaneous charting, financial management, RCM, patient portal, scheduling, e-prescriptions, compliance tracking, document management, lab integration, claims management, eligibility verification.

M&A advisory transaction page (Mufson Howe Hunter). Key metrics: 550+ medical practices, 2,200+ medical professionals, $1.7B+ in processed medical billings. Geographic focus: NY, NJ, PA. Deal announced Feb 20, 2020, terms undisclosed.
